photos.title: The eye
photos.description:
No image is real in itself,but some images are similar to reality, so it can be said that receiving existing messages from any image is formed from two subjective and objective sources.
For example portrait photography is re-creation of reality in which the structure has changed , these changes can be in the form of reducing, adding,changing
The angle of view and the color that add the photographer's mentality to the reality in front of the lens and thus increasing the sensitivity of the creator
Content forms meaning full form.

Displaying sensations would,in fact,have been impossible had it not been through form.
It is form that equips one to feel rather than see,the hesitant and agitated eyes of a persian girl.
Девушка в бирюзе на фоне цвета охры
